title: Dated Export Snapshots Delivery
summary: replace the latest-folder static HTML export with guarded dated snapshots of exact checked-document sets
content_html:
Dated Export Snapshots Delivery

Status And Purpose

DXS-1 through DXS-4 are complete for Dated Export Snapshots. Export owns the shipped contract. This delivery is closed and parked for closeout-list review; it is not retired by this checkpoint.

The existing static HTML exporter already proves the useful rendering seam, but its provider restriction, fixed latest-folder destination, immediate destructive apply, scope-only selection, broad same-scope link rewriting, and delete endpoint do not satisfy the snapshot contract. This delivery replaces that behavior through the existing Export workflow rather than adding another export system.

Complete Outcome

One Export item in the main index panel's Index Actions menu creates a browseable static HTML snapshot containing exactly the non-empty checked document set from the active configured scope. There is no export mode and no implicit descendant expansion. Select all naturally produces the whole-scope snapshot.

The destination is under $DOTLINEFORM_PROJECTS_BASE_DIR/docs-export/. From the server's local export date, the complete checked set is labelled <scope> - YYYY-MM-DD; every other checked set, including one checked document with unselected peers, is <scope> selection - YYYY-MM-DD. Complete-set classification takes precedence in a one-document scope because the checked ids cannot reveal whether Select all was clicked. The snapshot keeps original doc_id values and records the exact checked set in compact provenance.

If that exact dated folder is absent, confirmation creates it. If it exists, preflight identifies the existing recognized or unrecognized folder and offers only Replace or Cancel. Apply stages the complete new output before replacing a confirmed target and fails closed if the target changes after preflight.

The output is a user-owned visual and text reference. It is not canonical source, a managed archive, or a restore package.

Delivery Contract

Generated Input And Eligibility

  • Continue to read index-tree.json and by-id/<doc_id>.json; do not read or render canonical Markdown.
  • Resolve generated paths through configured scope providers. A configured scope is eligible when its generated tree and referenced document payloads are readable, whether the scope is public, repo-local, or external-local.
  • Do not use canonical-source availability or source writability as an export gate.
  • Include non-viewable documents already present in the manage generated tree.
  • Keep sub-scope report collections and their Actions menus outside this delivery; they are not part of the active scope's generated index tree.

Exact Snapshot Target

  • Accept any non-empty checked doc_id set from the active generated tree. Opening Index Actions retains its existing behavior of entering selection mode and explicitly checking the currently displayed document; once checked, that id follows the same no-fallback rule as every other Index Action.
  • Reject unknown, duplicate, stale, or cross-scope ids. Do not add parents, descendants, the active document, or any other unchecked id.
  • Normalize the validated set into generated tree order. Equality with the complete generated id set—not a browser mode field—identifies the whole-scope naming case.
  • Apply carries the scope, exact ordered doc_id values, local export date, normalized folder label, and preflight target revision as one validated plan. It does not reconstruct a different selection from presentation text.
  • Folder-name normalization is deterministic and limited to filesystem safety. Folder labels are presentation, not identity; provenance owns source identity.

Rendering And References

  • Reuse and focus the current static HTML renderer rather than creating a package profile or another browser renderer.
  • The snapshot index preserves an included parent/child relationship only when both documents are selected. A selected document with an unselected parent becomes a root.
  • Use the configured default document when it is selected; otherwise use the first selected document in generated tree order.
  • Rewrite a same-scope Docs Viewer link only when its target document is included in the snapshot. Preserve fragments.
  • Leave same-scope links to unselected documents, cross-scope links, remote links, media references, downloads, and interactive-asset references at their existing targets.
  • Continue to copy no media, download, script, style dependency, Mermaid render, or interactive-asset bytes.

Provenance And Guarded Replacement

  • Write one compact provenance record containing schema version, source scope, exact ordered selected doc_id values, document count, generated time, and artifact identity needed for replacement preflight.
  • Preview distinguishes an absent target, a recognized snapshot, an unrecognized existing directory, and a non-directory collision without exposing an absolute workspace root to the browser.
  • Existing directories require explicit replacement confirmation bound to the previewed destination state. A changed or newly occupied target fails and requires a fresh preview.
  • Render and write into a sibling staging directory, validate the staged file set, then perform the guarded same-filesystem replacement. A render, validation, or staging failure leaves an existing target untouched.
  • Remove the current static-export delete route and delete capability. Snapshot folders remain user-owned and Docs Viewer does not list, prune, rename, or delete them.

Singular Index Actions Workflow

  • Add one Export item to the main index panel's Index Actions menu and remove Export from the app-level Actions menu.
  • Reuse the existing Index Actions entry behavior that checks the currently displayed document. Do not add an Export-specific active-document fallback.
  • Enable Export for any non-empty eligible checked set. Do not add a mode chooser or an implicit descendant option.
  • Preflight validates the source, exact document set, complete-set classification, dated destination, and existing target state. The confirmation shows only Export N document(s) to: and the dated destination; the primary button carries Create, Replace, or Unavailable state.
  • An absent target has one create confirmation. An existing directory has Replace and Cancel only. A non-directory collision cannot be replaced.
  • Capability projection reports preview/apply availability from generated input and workspace readiness. It must not inherit the current source-availability gate or project absolute paths to the browser.
  • Do not add Export to sub-scope report Actions.

Likely Authority

  • docs-viewer/services/docs_static_html_export.py retains generated-payload loading, selection, rendering, destination planning, provenance, and guarded apply ownership.
  • docs_management_routes.py, docs_management_service.py, and docs_management_capabilities_service.py own the management-only preview/apply and capability boundary.
  • docs-viewer-action-definitions.js, docs-viewer-management-index-controller.js, and the index selection owner supply the Index Action and exact checked IDs without adding a fallback target.
  • docs-viewer-management-actions-renderer.js removes the app-level item; docs-viewer-management-client.js and the existing management modal owners retain the singular Export workflow.
  • test_docs_static_html_export.py, focused management route/capability tests, and a narrow runtime-module check own durable service and wiring evidence.
  • Export receives the shipped current-state contract.

Implementation may refine filenames after inspection, but must retain these ownership and no-fallback boundaries.

Delivery Checkpoints

[x] DXS-1 — Preview Contract And Write-Free Plan

  • [x] Define one write-free preview result for any non-empty exact checked-document set.
  • [x] Resolve readable generated inputs for repo-local, public, and external-local configured scopes without consulting canonical-source writability.
  • [x] Define deterministic complete-set and non-complete-set local-date naming, filesystem-safe label normalization, exact-set provenance, and target-state revision rules.
  • [x] Plan included document IDs in generated tree order and make internal-link rewriting membership-aware.
  • [x] Cover empty, duplicate, unknown, stale, and cross-scope ids; single, partial, and complete sets; absent, recognized, unrecognized, non-directory, and changed targets with focused pure/service tests.

Evidence:

  • docs_static_html_snapshot_preview_v1 returns the exact tree-ordered checked ids, selected hierarchy, deterministic default and dated label, plan revision, and content-sensitive destination revision without writing a snapshot or exposing an absolute workspace path. Complete sets use <scope> - YYYY-MM-DD; every non-complete set uses <scope> selection - YYYY-MM-DD.
  • The selected configured scope resolves its generated payload location through the repository or external-local provider. Public, repo-local, and external-local fixtures produce the same bounded plan; source availability and writability do not participate.
  • Exact selection rejects empty, duplicate, unsafe, stale/cross-scope, sub-scope, mode, and descendant-expansion inputs. Omitted parents promote selected children to roots, and only links to included documents are eligible for local rewriting.
  • Destination preview distinguishes absent, recognized, unrecognized, non-directory, and symlink targets. Recognized provenance is structurally validated, and target revisions change when names, metadata, or file bytes change.
  • The focused exporter and management-route suite passes 34 tests. Explicit five-file Python lint, bytecode compilation, and git diff --check pass.

Checkpoint: preview identifies one exact source, document set, dated destination, and replacement state without writing output. Stop for contract review before mutation work.

[x] DXS-2 — Staged Snapshot Apply

  • [x] Render the exact planned document set through the focused static HTML owner, preserving only included hierarchy.
  • [x] Write and validate the complete snapshot plus provenance in a sibling staging directory.
  • [x] Create an absent target or replace only the exact confirmed, unchanged existing target.
  • [x] Preserve the existing target on planning, rendering, staging, validation, or stale-confirmation failure.
  • [x] Remove latest-folder and static-export delete behavior rather than retaining compatibility routes or aliases.

Evidence:

  • Apply restores the previewed scope, exact tree-ordered ids, local date, plan revision, and content-sensitive target revision. It requires explicit confirmation and returns a browser-safe conflict requiring a fresh preview when the plan or target is stale.
  • The renderer writes only index.html, styles.css, snapshot.json, and the selected docs/<doc_id>.html files into a sibling staging directory. Validation checks the exact file set, bytes, entry types, and provenance before installation.
  • Absent targets are created without overwrite. Recognized and unrecognized directories require explicit replacement; non-directory collisions fail closed. The same-filesystem switch verifies the moved target by content and restores it if final installation fails.
  • Focused failures at rendering, staging, staged validation, stale confirmation, and the final switch preserve the existing target. Successful replacement leaves no staging or backup directory.
  • The fixed <scope> latest-folder writer, delete service, delete route, and compatibility action field are removed. The old app-level capability reports apply/delete false until DXS-3 replaces its browser workflow.
  • The exporter, route, and capability suite passes 46 tests. Explicit seven-file Python lint and bytecode compilation plus git diff --check pass.
  • A direct apply against the current Studio generated tree produced one dated four-file artifact for the feature document: its HTML page, index, stylesheet, and exact-id provenance.

Checkpoint: direct service and management-route evidence proves a complete dated artifact and guarded replacement, including failure preservation. Stop before browser integration.

[x] DXS-3 — Index Export Action

  • [x] Project preview/apply capability from readable generated data and external-workspace readiness for every supported configured scope.
  • [x] Move Export from the app-level Actions menu to the main index panel's Index Actions menu; do not add it to sub-scope Actions.
  • [x] Reuse the existing Index Actions entry behavior that explicitly checks the currently displayed document.
  • [x] Enable one Export workflow for any non-empty checked set without a mode chooser or descendant expansion.
  • [x] Supply the exact checked ids after Index Actions entry; let Select all produce the complete-set case.
  • [x] Show only the planned dated label and document count in the confirmation; carry create, replace, or unavailable state on the primary button.
  • [x] Refresh capability/result state after success without adding snapshot listing or lifecycle management.

Evidence:

  • Global capability requires a ready $DOTLINEFORM_PROJECTS_BASE_DIR/docs-export workspace; per-scope preview/apply requires a non-empty readable generated tree and every referenced payload. Repo-local, public, and external-local fixtures are enabled without consulting canonical-source availability, and unavailable responses expose no absolute workspace path.
  • export-docs is now an all-selection Action rendered only in the main Index Actions menu. The app-level item and dispatcher are removed; the sub-scope contribution remains unchanged and continues to expose no Export action.
  • The existing Index Actions entry owns selection mode and its displayed-document auto-check. Export resolves only selectedDocIds; a focused case with displayed document b and only a checked dispatches only a.
  • The browser validates that preview returns the exact checked set, dated label, selection kind, safe target state, and both revisions. Apply is assembled from that preview object only; it sends no mode, descendant, active-document, label-derived, or compatibility field.
  • Confirmation is limited to Export N document(s) to: and the dated destination. The primary button is Create snapshot, Replace, or disabled Unavailable; replacement retains cancel focus.
  • Successful apply preserves the checked selection, reports the result, and refreshes capabilities. No snapshot listing, delete, naming, or lifecycle surface is added.
  • The exporter/route/capability suite passes 47 tests. The Index selection/workflow module check and real management-shell smoke pass; the module check includes the rendered confirmation modal and exact preview/apply request bodies. Explicit ten-file JavaScript lint and syntax checks, six-file Python lint, and git diff --check pass.

Checkpoint: the local management workflow exports exactly the checked set and cannot replace or add any document that was not explicitly confirmed. Stop for user workflow review.

[x] DXS-4 — Verification And Authority Transfer

  • [x] Run focused exporter, route, capability, and runtime-module evidence plus explicit Python/JavaScript lint, syntax or compilation checks, and git diff --check.
  • [x] Inspect representative single, partial, Select-all, selected-child-without-parent, same-scope-unselected link, public-scope, external-local, recognized replacement, and unrecognized collision artifacts without treating the samples as subsystem-wide coverage.
  • [x] Rebuild Studio docs and search projections when the watcher has not already done so.
  • [x] Update Export from shipped behavior and remove its latest-folder/delete contract.
  • [x] Run the mandatory end-of-delivery diff and evidence review before changing feature or delivery status.

Evidence:

  • A disposable curated fixture audit produced six inspected snapshot folders without touching the user workspace: a single selected child promoted to a root with its unselected-parent link preserved, a nested partial parent/child selection with a localized link, a complete Studio set, a public Library set, an external-local set, and an explicitly confirmed unrecognized-folder replacement. Re-preview and apply also replaced the recognized single-selection target. Every artifact's file set and provenance matched its exact ids, and no staging, backup, or symlink entry remained. These samples cover only those named surfaces, not arbitrary content or every configured scope.
  • Artifact inspection exposed and corrected the singular index copy from 1 documents exported to 1 document exported; the curated audit and focused coverage pass after the correction.
  • The focused exporter, route, and capability suite passes 47 tests. The Index selection/workflow module check passes, including exact modal text, selection preservation, and exact preview/apply requests. The maintained docs-viewer-smoke profile passes 25/25, including source lint, site validation, Index lifecycle routes, the real management shell, public read-only Docs Viewer, and adjacent workflow regression surfaces.
  • Explicit ten-file JavaScript lint and syntax checks, six-file Python lint, four-service bytecode compilation, generated Studio docs/search consistency, and git diff --check pass.
  • Export now describes only the shipped dated-snapshot workflow, input/provider boundary, exact selection, guarded replacement, artifact contract, ownership, and verification surfaces. Its former fixed latest-folder, repo-only, app-level Action, delete, and absolute-destination contracts are removed.

Checkpoint: the dated snapshot contract is shipped, focused evidence is reconciled to its exact surfaces, and durable Export documentation is current.

Out Of Scope

  • canonical Markdown, source-faithful JSONL, asset collection, or dependency packaging;
  • restore, import, Docs Review, return, synchronization, or canonical writes;
  • snapshot registry, browser, archive scope, history, retention, pruning, rename, or deletion;
  • arbitrary destination or name selection, Save As, more than one snapshot per equivalent label and local date, or background scheduling;
  • implicit parent or descendant expansion, an Include descendants option, sub-scope report collections, or cross-scope combined snapshots;
  • copied media, downloads, interactive dependencies, remote assets, or rendered Mermaid SVGs;
  • Publish, Data Sharing package, Copy/Move, or standalone-application work; and
  • broad modal redesign or UI choreography tests.

Completion Gates

  • Any non-empty checked set produces a complete browseable artifact from generated payloads through one renderer and one main-index Action.
  • Export is absent from app-level and sub-scope Actions.
  • Snapshot membership comes only from validated checked ids; Select all is the whole-scope case and the existing Index Actions auto-check is the only displayed-document handoff.
  • The snapshot index preserves selected hierarchy, promotes selected orphans to roots, and chooses its default deterministically.
  • Every eligible configured provider family is accepted on generated readability rather than canonical-source ownership.
  • Same-scope links are local only when their target is included; excluded and external targets remain usable at their original locations.
  • An existing target is never removed before explicit, state-bound replacement confirmation and complete staged output.
  • Provenance distinguishes source identity from a colliding presentation label.
  • Browser-visible payloads omit absolute project paths and no delete or archive-management capability remains.
  • Focused negative evidence covers traversal, unsafe labels, missing payloads, invalid targets, stale confirmation, non-directory collision, render/write failure, and provider eligibility.
  • Durable Export documentation and generated Studio projections describe the shipped contract.
  • Final review finds no second renderer, package-profile coupling, browser mode field, selection expansion or fallback, compatibility delete path, or unplanned archive lifecycle.
